findings.title: DurableTaskEngine executes tasks strictly serially
evidence: core/android/.../reliability/DurableTaskEngine.kt: drain() holds workerMutex and joins each task
findings.recommendation: Implement a dedicated parallel scheduler in the module; reuse the engine only as a pattern.

findings.title: GitLite has a single working tree and no merge
evidence: core/engine/.../vcs/GitLite.kt header: no merge, rebase or worktree
findings.impact: Git worktrees and Git-based merging are not available.
findings.recommendation: Use CAS-backed workspace forks and an in-module three-way merge.

findings.title: ChatSession (1525 lines) and HarnessBridge (1232 lines) are oversized and coupled to chat persistence/UI
findings.impact: Adding multi-agent logic there would worsen coupling.
findings.recommendation: Do not modify; compose ProviderClient, BoltStreamParser, ActionDispatcher and PatchEngine in a new runner.

findings.title: RealProjectFileSystem already enforces confinement, atomic writes and symlink safety
findings.impact: Positive: reuse avoids duplicating security-critical code.

findings.title: SAF workspaces fail closed in the runtime gateway
findings.impact: SAF-backed projects cannot host isolated workspaces.
findings.recommendation: Real-path-only engine; SAF import gateway deferred.

findings.title: Room database anvex.db is at schema version 13 with verified schema snapshots
Test infrastructure present: JUnit 4.13.2 and 83 test indicators
findings.impact: Module tests can follow existing conventions.

currentState.summary: Anvex 4.15.2 is a multi-module Android app (core:model, core:engine, core:ai, core:android, app) with a single-agent chat engine, a harness web UI, Room database version 13 and a manual DI graph.
architecture: core:engine is pure JVM (parser, dispatcher, patch engine, safety policy, ProjectFileSystem)
core:android holds sessions, Room, services, RealProjectFileSystem
app holds Compose UI and AppGraph

targetState.summary: Anvex gains a separable multi-agent module (four Gradle modules) integrated only at contract points.

migration.strategy: Build the module completely in a copy of Anvex 4.15.2, then integrate at the listed contract points.
migration.rollback: Remove the include lines, dependency lines, graph wiring, route and strings; agents.db is separate and can be deleted without affecting anvex.db.
